ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The change of population number with time under ideal conditions, the change of DNA content with time in one cell cycle, the change of reaction rate with enzyme amount when conditions are suitable and substrate is sufficient, and the change of photosynthetic intensity with CO2 content under suitable conditions. Among the above four phenomena, which can be represented by the figure?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: The change of photosynthetic intensity with CO2 content under suitable conditions

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The change of population number with time under ideal conditions, the change of DNA content with time in one cell cycle, the change of reaction rate with enzyme amount when conditions are suitable and substrate is sufficient, and the change of photosynthetic intensity with CO2 content under suitable conditions. Among the above four phenomena, which can be represented by the figure?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a coordinate curve, and the horizontal axis and vertical axis are not marked with specific names; the curve starts near the origin, rises as the horizontal-axis variable increases, but the extent of increase gradually decreases, and finally tends toward a horizontal plateau, indicating a relationship of “first increasing, then tending to stability due to limiting factors.” Then reason: The change of population number with time under ideal conditions is usually J-shaped exponential growth and will not show a plateau; the change of DNA content with time in one cell cycle shows relative stability, replication increase, then stability again, and a decrease after division, not this kind of smooth saturation curve; when conditions are suitable and substrate is sufficient, the reaction rate usually rises approximately in a directly proportional straight line with increasing enzyme amount; under suitable conditions, photosynthetic intensity will first increase as CO2 content increases, and when other factors become limiting factors, it will tend to stability. Therefore, the figure can represent the change of photosynthetic intensity with CO2 content under suitable conditions.
